ارتضخوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَخُوا (irtaḍaḵū) /ir.ta.dˤa.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اُرْتُضِخُوا (urtuḍiḵū) /ur.tu.dˤi.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اِرْتَضِخُوا (irtaḍiḵū) /ir.ta.dˤi.xuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
